story.p1: Finding a reliable iPhone, genuine American skincare or your favorite cookies in Abidjan often meant inflated prices, counterfeits and middlemen who disappeared once paid.
story.p2: So we did the opposite: order directly from suppliers in the United States, show clear prices in FCFA, and stay reachable from the first message to delivery.

banner.title: Frequently asked questions
banner.subtitle: Orders, delivery from the US, returns, payment: every answer in one place.

item1.title: Are items in stock?
item1.description: Our items are ordered from suppliers in the United States when you place your order. If an item is no longer available, we let you know quickly and offer a full refund, an equivalent item or waiting for restock.

item2.title: How do I track my order?
item2.description: Follow your order at any time from the “My orders” section of your account. As soon as your parcel is handed to our courier, you are notified by SMS, WhatsApp or email.

item3.title: Can I change or cancel my order?
item3.description: Contact us as soon as possible. As long as your item has not yet been ordered from our supplier, we can change or cancel the order. After that, the return conditions apply.

item4.title: How long does delivery take?
item4.description: Delivery time includes shipping your items from the United States to Abidjan, then delivery to your address. The estimated time is shown when you order; it may vary with supplier availability, customs and peak periods.

item5.title: Where do you deliver?
item5.description: We deliver everywhere in Abidjan and to the main cities in Côte d'Ivoire. For any other destination, contact us to check availability and fees. Delivery is free from 25,000 FCFA, in the areas shown at checkout.

item6.title: How long do I have to return an item?
item6.description: You have 14 days from receiving your order to request a return or exchange. The item must be in its original, unused condition, with its packaging, labels and accessories.

item7.title: How do I exchange an item?
item7.description: If an item doesn't suit you in size, color or model and is still in its original condition, an exchange is possible within the same time limit as a return, subject to availability from our suppliers. Otherwise, we offer a refund or store credit.

item8.title: My parcel is damaged or the item doesn't match
item8.description: Check your parcel on receipt, ideally in front of the courier. If an item is damaged, incomplete or different from your order, contact us within 48 hours with photos of the product and packaging: we will exchange or refund it at no cost to you.

item9.title: Which items can't be returned?
item9.description: For hygiene and safety reasons, unless defective: opened skincare and cosmetics, opened toothpaste, mouthwash and whitening kits, unpacked raw hair, fragrances with a broken seal, grocery products and items marked “final sale”.

item10.title: How do I start a return?
item10.description: Contact us from the Contact page or from “My orders”, stating the item and the reason. We will then tell you how to send it back.

item11.title: Are the products authentic?
item11.description: Yes. Every item is sourced from suppliers in the United States. New iPhones are delivered sealed in their original packaging; pre-owned items are delivered in the condition described on their page.

item12.title: What condition are pre-owned iPhones in?
item12.description: Each pre-owned iPhone is delivered in the condition described on its page. On receipt, check the screen, battery, camera and network, and report any issue within 48 hours with photos or video.

item13.title: Which payment methods do you accept?
item13.description: Mobile Money (Wave, Orange Money, MTN Money, Moov Money), bank card (Visa, Mastercard) through our secure payment provider, or cash on delivery depending on your area. Available methods are shown at checkout.

item14.title: Is my payment data secure?
item14.description: Card and Mobile Money payments are processed directly by our payment providers: your banking details are not stored on our servers.

item15.title: How do I reset my password?
item15.description: On the login page, click “Forgot password” and follow the instructions sent by email to choose a new one.

item16.title: How do I delete my account?
item16.description: Send us a request from the Contact page with the email address linked to your account. We will delete it as soon as possible and confirm it to you.

bottomBanner.title: Can't find your answer?
bottomBanner.subtitle: Our team replies within one business day.

zones.title: Delivery areas
zones.description: PrettyFull delivers everywhere in Abidjan (Cocody, Marcory, Yopougon, Plateau, Riviera and other districts) and to the main cities across Côte d'Ivoire. For any other destination, contact our customer service to check availability and fees.

delays.title: Delivery times
delays.description: Our items are ordered from suppliers in the United States, so delivery time includes international shipping to Abidjan and then delivery to your address. The estimated time is shown when you order. It may vary with supplier availability, international transport, customs and peak periods (holidays, sales).

fees.title: Delivery fees
fees.description: Delivery fees depend on your area and are shown before payment. Delivery is free from 25,000 FCFA, in the areas indicated at checkout.

tracking.title: Order tracking
tracking.description: You can follow your order at any time from the “My orders” section of your account. As soon as your parcel is handed to our courier, you are notified by SMS, WhatsApp or email.

damagedParcel.title: Damaged, incomplete or non-conforming parcel
damagedParcel.description: Check your parcel on receipt, ideally in front of the courier. If an item is damaged, incomplete or doesn't match your order, contact our customer service within 48 hours with photos of the product and packaging. After review, we will exchange or refund it at no cost to you.

returnWindow.title: Return and exchange window
returnWindow.description: You have 14 days from receiving your order to request a return or exchange. To start one, contact our customer service from the Contact page or from “My orders”, stating the reason.

returnConditions.title: Return conditions
returnConditions.description: To be accepted, an item must be returned in its original, unused condition, in its original packaging with all labels and accessories (cables, manuals, box).

refund.title: Refunds
refund.description: Once the returned item is received and checked, you will be told whether the return is accepted. If accepted, the refund is made to the original payment method or as store credit, as you prefer. Original delivery fees are only refunded in case of a defect or an error on our side.

nonReturnable.title: Non-returnable items
nonReturnable.description: For hygiene and safety reasons, the following cannot be returned or exchanged unless defective: opened skincare and cosmetics, opened toothpaste, mouthwash and whitening kits, unpacked raw hair, fragrances with a broken seal and grocery products. The same applies to items marked “final sale”.

exchange.title: Size, color or model exchange
exchange.description: If an item doesn't suit you in size, color or model and is still in its original condition, an exchange is possible within the same time limits and conditions as a return, subject to availability from our suppliers. Otherwise, we offer a refund or store credit.

iphones.title: New and pre-owned iPhones
iphones.description: New iPhones are delivered sealed in their original packaging: a return is only possible if the packaging has not been opened. Pre-owned iPhones are delivered in the condition described on their page; check the device (screen, battery, camera, network) on receipt and report any issue within 48 hours with photos or video.

ShippingReturnPage.intro: Everything you need to know about how your items travel from the US, how they are delivered in Abidjan and Côte d'Ivoire, and how to return an item.
ShippingReturnPage.contactLabel: Unsure about a delivery or a return? Write to us.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: These Terms and Conditions of Sale govern all sales made on the PrettyFull website: phones and computers (new and pre-owned iPhones), face and body care, oral care, fragrances, hair, fashion and accessories, and American groceries. Placing an order implies full acceptance of these terms. PrettyFull may update them at any time; the version in force on the day of the order applies.

products.title: Products and availability
products.description: Items are sourced from suppliers in the United States and imported for delivery in Côte d'Ivoire. Each product page shows a description, photos and, for pre-owned items, the stated condition. Availability depends on our suppliers: if an item becomes unavailable after your order, we will let you know promptly and offer a full refund, an equivalent item or waiting for restock.

prices.title: Prices and currency
prices.description: All prices displayed on the site are expressed in CFA Francs (FCFA / XOF), all taxes included, excluding delivery fees which are specified before final order confirmation. PrettyFull reserves the right to change its prices at any time, it being understood that the price applicable to an order is the one in effect at the time the Customer confirms it.

payment.title: Payment methods
payment.description: Orders can be paid via Mobile Money (Wave, Orange Money, MTN Money, Moov Money), by credit card (Visa, Mastercard) through our secure payment provider, or by cash on delivery depending on the delivery area and terms specified at checkout. The order is only finally confirmed after payment confirmation or, for cash on delivery, after phone confirmation by our team.

orderValidation.title: Order confirmation
orderValidation.description: Before confirming, a summary (items, models, sizes or colors, prices, delivery address) is shown for you to check. Once confirmed, a summary is sent to you by email and/or message. PrettyFull may cancel any order in case of a previous payment dispute or reasonable doubt about its validity.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Because items are ordered from our US suppliers and imported, delivery time includes international shipping to Abidjan and then delivery to your address. The estimated time and applicable fees are shown before payment and detailed in the “Shipping & Returns” section. You agree to provide an accurate address and a reachable phone number; PrettyFull is not liable for delays or failed delivery caused by an incorrect address.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.description: You may change your mind and request a return or exchange under the conditions set out in our “Shipping & Returns” policy. For hygiene reasons, the following are excluded: opened skincare and cosmetics, opened oral care products, unpacked raw hair and food products. Items must be returned in their original condition, with packaging and labels.

returns.title: Returns, exchanges and refunds
returns.description: The precise terms for returns, exchanges and refunds (timeframes, excluded items, procedure and possible fees) are detailed on our dedicated "Shipping and Returns" page, which forms an integral part of these Terms. Every refund is issued to the same payment method used for the purchase, unless otherwise agreed with the Customer.

warranty.title: Warranty and conformity
warranty.description: PrettyFull undertakes to deliver items that match their description. New iPhones are delivered sealed in their original packaging; pre-owned iPhones are delivered in the condition described on their page. If an item is defective on receipt (damaged parcel, non-conforming item, wrong reference), report it to our customer service promptly with photos so we can offer an exchange or refund at no extra cost.

personalData.title: Personal data
personalData.description: Personal information collected when ordering (identity, contact details, delivery address, purchase history) is used solely for processing and tracking orders as well as, with the Customer's consent, for marketing communications. This data is neither sold nor transferred to third parties not involved in fulfilling the order (carrier, payment provider). In accordance with applicable data protection regulations, the Customer has the right to access, rectify and delete their data, which they may exercise by contacting us via the site's Contact page.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.description: All elements of the PrettyFull site (logo, visual identity, product photographs, text, layout) are protected by intellectual property law and remain the exclusive property of PrettyFull. Any reproduction, representation or use, in whole or in part, of these elements without prior written authorization is strictly prohibited.

liability.title: Liability
liability.description: PrettyFull cannot be held liable for damage resulting from improper use of the website, force majeure (including delays related to international shipping or customs), or failures of the internet or payment operators beyond its control. Product photos are as accurate as possible but may differ slightly from the item received (packaging, shade, version).

jurisdiction.title: Governing law and disputes
jurisdiction.description: These Terms and Conditions of Sale are governed by Ivorian law. In the event of a dispute regarding the interpretation or performance of an order, the Customer is invited to first contact our customer service to seek an amicable solution. Failing an amicable agreement, the competent courts of Côte d'Ivoire shall have sole jurisdiction over the dispute.

productInformation.title: Product information
productInformation.description: Skincare, cosmetics and hygiene products are made in the USA and may be labelled in English. Before first using a skincare product, check the ingredient list and test it on a small area of skin; stop using it if a reaction occurs. American grocery products should be consumed according to the packaging, including the best-before date and allergens.

TermsPage.intro: These terms govern every order placed on PrettyFull: products imported from the US, prices, payment, delivery in Abidjan and returns. They apply as soon as your order is confirmed.
TermsPage.contactLabel: A question about these terms? Our team will answer.
